# HVACLists

> HVACLists (hvaclists.com) is a directory of heating and air conditioning companies in Dayton, Ohio and the Miami Valley. It is not an HVAC contractor. Listed companies are checked against public sources such as the City of Dayton Registered Heating Contractors list, and each listing shows the company's phone, areas served and registration number. Paid Featured spots are labeled. HVACLists does not publish star ratings or invented prices.

## Key pages
- [HVAC companies in Dayton, OH](https://hvaclists.com/dayton-oh/): city hub
- [AC repair in Dayton](https://hvaclists.com/dayton-oh/ac-repair/)
- [Furnace repair in Dayton](https://hvaclists.com/dayton-oh/furnace/)
- [HVAC installation in Dayton](https://hvaclists.com/dayton-oh/hvac-installation/)
- [Emergency HVAC in Dayton](https://hvaclists.com/dayton-oh/emergency-hvac/)
- [AC repair in Kettering, OH](https://hvaclists.com/kettering-oh/ac-repair/)
- [For HVAC companies](https://hvaclists.com/for-pros/)

## How listings work
- Every listed company comes from a public source cited on the page.
- Homeowners can call a listed company directly or send a quote request; requests go to owner@ateamcontractings.com.
- Featured (paid placement) is labeled on the page.

## Company profiles
Independent profiles of heating and cooling companies people search for by name. Each shows Ohio OCILB license status, City of Dayton registration where it exists, services and areas as the company lists them, and the public sources. The companies did not write or pay for these pages.
- [All company profiles](https://hvaclists.com/companies/)
- [Cloverleaf Mechanical (Cloverleaf Heating, Air & Plumbing), Springfield, OH](https://hvaclists.com/companies/cloverleaf-mechanical-springfield-oh/): Ohio HVAC license HV.22959, active; ownership changed August 2025
- [Korrect Plumbing, Heating & Air Conditioning, Dayton, OH](https://hvaclists.com/companies/korrect-plumbing-heating-air-dayton-oh/): Ohio HVAC licenses HV.48006 and HV.51236, plumbing PL.13223; City of Dayton heating registration 902
